messages:
Maria CS: Heads-up — onboarding customers in the 'bulk-ingest' cohort (~20 accounts) are seeing elevated embeddings 5xx during nightly reindexes. Several have open tickets. Working with eng to mitigate. Draft comm below, need approvals.

Sam Eng: Confirmed. Root cause looks like a batch worker hitting OOM on a quantized model variant. Rolling restart for the worker pool and temporary fallback to CPU quantized path for small batches. Monitoring.

Maria CS: Timeline?

Sam Eng: Rolling restart now; should clear ~5-10m per pool. Fallback rolling config applied, expected reduced throughput but stable. Will update when all pools back.

Nina Support: We've got 4 tickets flagged as high-touch, customers A-D requested ETA. Need a short status update we can send them ASAP. Also, can we get a templated blurb for community/console status?

Maria CS: Draft for affected customers (short):

[Draft message]
Hi — we’re investigating increased 5xx errors affecting embeddings for some onboarding customers during large reindexes. We’ve rolled a mitigation (worker restart + fallback) and are monitoring. You might see reduced throughput for a short window. We’ll follow up with an RCA and any credits if you were impacted. If you need immediate help, reply here and we’ll schedule a live troubleshooting session.

Looking for :thumbsup: or changes.

Kevin AE: Good. For renewal-risk accounts, propose auto-applying a one-time service credit (2 days pro-rated) and offering a 1-hr enablement with an engineer. Approve?

Maria CS: Approved to offer 2-day credit + 1hr session for accounts with active onboarding contracts. For free-tier or low-risk, we'll offer just the session. Need finance ok for credits — @Kevin AE can you confirm budget?

Kevin AE: I'll route to finance now. Also suggest adding an opt-in for a dedicated pool trial for 2 weeks to mitigate recurrence.

Sam Eng: FYI — we also identified one automation that retried large batches too aggressively. We'll push a rate-limit change to the retry loop; patch arriving in 30m. That should stop recurrence.

Maria CS: Great. Nina, I'll post the short status to tickets + add lines for SLA credit eligibility. Also will draft a public console status message.

Nina Support: Thanks. Can you include a small FAQ: 'Was my data exposed?' — answer: no. 'Do I need to change config?' — answer: no, unless you want help optimizing batch size.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0042. Priority P2. Link: https://incidents.internal/redwood/INC-2026-0042

Maria CS: Final check — message to impacted customers:

Hi <customer>,
We encountered increased 5xx errors for embeddings during large batched reindexes between 20:10-21:05 UTC. We've applied mitigations and monitoring shows stability. We’ll provide an RCA and will proactively apply a 2-day service credit + offer a 1-hr troubleshooting session if you're in onboarding. Reply to this thread to accept. Apologies for the disruption.

Send?

Kevin AE: Send. :thumbsup:

Sam Eng: Confirmed all worker pools restarted, fallback in place, retry limiter patched. Closing loop from eng at 21:00 UTC. Will post RCA draft in 24-48h.

Maria CS: Sending now. I'll update thread with responses and credit list. Thanks all.
